Container.Name: airlog-web
Container.Overview: Airlog dashboard: capture progress, song history, audio playback, review, and storage status. Install all three Airlog containers. Appdata and Audio storage must point to the same host folders in all three templates.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite and service status. Use a direct local pool path; replace cache with your pool name. Same host path in all three templates.

Config.Name: Audio storage
Config.Description: Recordings, durable queue, and recovery files. Same host path in all three templates.

Config.Name: Stream URL
Config.Description: Direct audio stream URL compatible with FFmpeg. Set this for your station. Use the same value across all three containers.

Config.Name: Stream Name
Config.Description: Label shown in the dashboard for this stream. Example: Walmart Radio.

Config.Name: Metadata URL
Config.Description: Optional metadata endpoint for the stream. Leave blank when unavailable. Used by the worker.

Config.Name: Chunk length (seconds)
Config.Description: 10 to 30 seconds. Must match across all three containers.

Config.Name: Free space reserve (GB)
Config.Description: Pause capture below this amount of free space. Match across all three containers.

Config.Name: Recognition provider
Config.Description: shazam for free unofficial recognition, or none to disable. Match worker and web values.

Config.Name: Recognition interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Minimum interval between recognition attempts. Match worker and web values.

Config.Name: Metadata interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Metadata polling interval, at least 5 seconds. Used by the worker.

Config.Name: Retention grace period (hours)
Config.Description: Minimum age before permitted deletion. Match worker and web values.

Config.Name: Automatically delete matched music
Config.Description: false keeps audio unless manually released. true enables heuristic deletion, which can miss speech over music. Match worker and web values.

Config.Name: Dashboard username
Config.Description: Username for optional HTTP Basic authentication.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Leave empty for no built-in authentication. Use HTTPS when accessing remotely.
